trust_decision.summary: A model-supplied git revision must be rejected before it becomes a git argv element: the tool handlers refuse empty, leading-'-' and control-character revisions, so an option-shaped rev cannot be parsed by git as an option.

landing_point.why: The published summary names the git_show tool, and its `rev` value is taken straight from tool input here and pushed as the last positional argv element at git_history.rs:225 with no shape check.

fix_sites.where: fix.diff:29-49 (new helper; absent at the pinned commit)
fix_sites.entry_point: validate_git_rev, shared helper called from both handlers at fix.diff:13 and fix.diff:21

O3_reason_to_dismiss: `base` on the review tool is a diff base ref for a code-review request, not a revision to display; the review feature is a separate card with its own input schema, so a solver can argue the advisory and its fix apply to the git history tools only.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-SHA revisions must keep working: the git_show schema promises "commit SHA, tag, branch, or ref expression", so `HEAD`, hyphenated branch/tag names, `origin/main:src/lib.rs` and ranges like `main..feature` are legitimate; an allowlist of hex SHAs, or a ban on '-' anywhere, ':' or '..', breaks them (and the existing rev="HEAD" test at git_history.rs:568). git_blame also defaults rev to HEAD at git_history.rs:341.

O6_input_shapes: revision containing NUL or ASCII control characters
whitespace-padded revision (trimmed before the checks, so ' --x ' is still rejected)
same rev supplied on a required field (git_show) and on an optional field that defaults to HEAD (git_blame)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: review tool: `base` is interpolated into one git argv element `<base>...HEAD` for `git diff` with no option check; an option-shaped base is parsed as a git diff option (e.g. `--output=<path>`), running under ReadOnly+Auto approval
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The review tool is a separate code-review card, its field is called a diff base ref rather than a revision to show, and the card is read-only, so the advisory reads as being about git_show/git_blame only.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same crate, different module: tools/review.rs vs tools/git_history.rs, reached through a different tool (registered at registry.rs:832-833)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI `review --base <ref>` builds the identical `<base>...HEAD` argument for `git diff` with no option check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a human-typed CLI flag on the caller's own argv, not model tool input, so a solver can say the advisory's threat model (model-chosen tool arguments) does not cover it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and entry surface (CLI subcommand in main.rs) from the tool handler

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a `base`/`compare` input on the git_diff tool, interpolated as `<base>...HEAD`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: git_diff already exists with `cached` and `path` but no base ref, and review.rs:374 shows the exact interpolation idiom a maintainer copies when adding 'diff against a base branch'.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a `rev_range`/`branch` input on git_log, pushed as its own argv element
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: git_log already treats author/since/until as free-form user strings and builds a positional list; a range argument is the obvious next field and would take the same unvalidated path as the old git_show rev.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a pathspec-style input that is not preceded by `--`
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both git tools append pathspecs after `--` (git.rs:74, git.rs:172); a variant that appends a user path directly would reintroduce the same argument-injection class through the path route.
